# Third-Party Materials

Kancil may use software, hardware designs, CAD models, documentation, and other materials created by third parties.

Materials created by third parties are **not automatically covered by Kancil's licenses**. They remain subject to their respective licenses and terms.

This directory is used to document third-party materials that are distributed with, derived from, or otherwise incorporated into the Kancil project.

This directory contains licensing and attribution information
for third-party components used directly by Kancil.

Transitive dependencies may not be individually reproduced here
when their licenses and attribution notices are already provided
through their respective package distributions.

See the project's dependency manifests and lockfiles for the
complete dependency tree.
